data.source_title: Epic on FHIR Developer Testing Guide: Epic Instances and Environments
data.locator: Developer Testing Guide, Epic Instances and Environments, especially FHIR Developer Sandbox paragraphs
data.source_setting: Epic FHIR Developer Sandbox, a shared testing environment; Epic distinguishes each customer's own training, test, reporting, support, and production environments.
data.source_n: One Epic-provided FHIR Sandbox; documentation says it refreshes weekly on Sunday about 8 p.m. Central and prior-week written data is erased.
data.source_evidence_basis: Epic documents separate customer instances and environments, identifies its single public FHIR Sandbox as a developer-testing resource, and describes weekly refresh and quarterly-version upgrade downtime.
data.limitations: The public FHIR Sandbox is for API development/testing, not a full customer-specific Epic Hyperspace training playground or faithful RWJBH workflow replica. Capabilities and configuration differ across customer instances; sandbox persistence is limited. Documentation describes APIs and testing, not human learner outcomes.
data.inferred_scenario_use: Use for integration/API proof-of-concept only. A local agent-training simulator could model workflows but should be clearly labeled separate from Epic and validated against authorized site-specific workflows before any training-transfer claim.
